final_text:
I visited both websites and sent each person feedback.

- **Dora:** I invited her to Slack using the email on her site (dora@gmail.com), then messaged her. I said her site is clean, simple and easy to contact. I suggested adding more about her projects, interests and background, plus some visual design.
- **Eve:** I messaged her directly. I said her blog has a personal voice and that I liked the hiking mention. I suggested adding posts and photos about her hikes, and a way for readers to connect or subscribe.

The tools returned no confirmation either way. I couldn't confirm that Dora accepted
